Replay & mobile follow-up

Keep the mission in view.

Live Castles share one replay timeline. Playback preserves elapsed time through events and project changes; imported recordings keep their own extent. On mobile, Map, Missions, Activity, and View open the existing surfaces, with replay and Go live within reach.

The dock reuses the original controls. Measured viewport, header, and dock space drive compact, short-landscape, and tablet layouts; camera controls expand when requested. The readiness guide separates the incoming 71-test/57-audit record and earlier 51-test/72-audit baseline from verification of this combined source. The combined source suite passed 207 tests, and clean extraction/rebuilding passed. The recorded browser results apply to their earlier fingerprints.

01 / Architecture

One authoritative path.
Several useful surfaces.

The proposal gives each component a defined responsibility. The visual map consumes the system's state; canonical owners govern execution and protected changes.

Read the ownership contract →
ComponentResponsibility
CovenDaemon authority, persistence, sessions, and state transitions
PsycheMissions, tasks, lanes, attempts, leases, and recovery semantics
Host & CastlesPortable workspace arrangement and project scope; exact ownership mapping to be verified
SDK & ThreadsCanonical client bindings and protected-surface proposal/commit boundaries
CLI · Build · CaveCoordinated human and coding surfaces over the canonical contracts
Familiar ContractExact persistent identity and revision binding before work
02 / Proposed delivery sequence

Start with one real, read-only Castle.

Open implementation packets →
  1. 01

    Discover and pin

    Current repositories, owners, exact revisions, canonical schemas, and acceptance gates.

  2. 02

    Project real state

    One Castle, exact familiar binding, mission state, decisions, and visible freshness.

  3. 03

    Wire proposals and receipts

    Authenticated intent, immutable preconditions, refusal, and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.

  4. 04

    Qualify bounded execution

    One task and authority owner, with leases, fencing, cancellation, limits, and durable recovery.

  5. 05

    Prove Host synchronization

    Portable inputs and immutable outputs, with conflicts and interrupted recovery made explicit.

  6. 06

    Align the clients

    Atlas, CLI, Psyche Build, and approved Cave surfaces consume the same semantics.

  7. 07

    Package and accept

    Pin source and runtime evidence, test the installed surface, and qualify the bounded pilot.

03 / Run the handoff

Extract. Verify. Explore.

No npm install or application build is required. The reference source needed by the tests is bundled. Use the local preview command on your development machine.

In an extracted copy, run python3 scripts/build-handoff.py to recreate the ZIP download.

Execution playbook →
python3 scripts/verify-handoff.py .
node scripts/check-source.mjs
node --test tests/*.test.cjs
node scripts/test-atlas-crown.mjs
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
